lines.text: I call a letter; the basket answers with color.
Look at shape, look at skin, then name the produce together.
A—Apricot! Apricot orange round | one hard pit at center can be found
B ... B ... Banana. A banana is a long curved fruit with a peel around soft flesh.
Cherry steps in for C. It is a small round stone fruit with one hard pit inside.
What does D reveal? Date! A date is an oval fruit with wrinkled skin around sweet flesh and one elongated stone.
across the color-call produce stall, E meets Eggplant. Eggplant smooth and long | leafy cap and seeded flesh make the clue strong
F—Fig! It is a soft fruit with thin skin and many tiny seeds packed inside.
G ... G ... Guava. Guava is a round or oval fruit with fragrant flesh and many small seeds inside.
Horseradish steps in for H. It is grown for its long pale pungent root below the soil.
Letter calls, color replies!
Name the produce with your eyes!
What does I reveal? Indian Fig! Indian Fig cactus-grown | colored skin and tiny seeds are shown
across the color-call produce stall, J meets Jackfruit. It is a very large fruit with a rough bumpy rind and many yellow fleshy pods inside.
K—Kale! It is leafy produce with broad leaves that may be flat, ruffled, or curly.
L ... L ... Leek. A leek has long flat green leaves and a pale layered lower stalk.
Melon steps in for M. Melon round and wide | firm rind, juicy seeded center inside
What does N reveal? Nectarine! A nectarine is a smooth-skinned stone fruit related to the peach, with one hard pit inside.
across the color-call produce stall, O meets Okra. It is a green ridged pod with rows of round seeds inside.
P—Peach! It is a stone fruit with fuzzy skin and one hard pit inside.
Q ... Q ... Quince. Quince in the crate | skin, leaf, root, or seed helps us identify it straight
Raspberry steps in for R. It is made of many tiny connected drupelets forming one soft clustered fruit.
What does S reveal? Strawberry! A strawberry has red flesh with many tiny seed-like achenes visible on the outside surface.
across the color-call produce stall, T meets Turnip. It has a rounded edible root below the soil and leafy greens above.
Letter calls, color replies!
Name the produce with your eyes!
U—Ugli Fruit! Ugli Fruit rough rind | loose citrus peel makes the clue easy to find
V ... V ... Vanilla Bean. A vanilla bean is a long narrow cured seed pod from a vanilla orchid.
Watercress steps in for W. It has small rounded green leaves on tender branching stems and grows in wet places.
What does X reveal? Xoconostle! Xoconostle is a tart fruit from a prickly pear cactus, with a thick skin and seeded center.
across the color-call produce stall, Y meets Yam. Yam in the crate | skin, leaf, root, or seed helps us identify it straight
Z—Zucchini! It is a long green summer squash with pale flesh and soft seeds inside.
The baskets rest between garden and market. Now call the colors, shapes, and names back.
A ... Apricot! Make a small round fruit; tap one pit at center.
Remember B ... Banana! Trace one long curve and peel line.
C? ... Cherry! Make one tiny round fruit and pit dot.
Find D, hold the beat ... Date! Trace an oval fruit; mark one long stone.
E ... Eggplant! Trace a smooth long fruit with a leafy cap.
Remember F ... Fig! Make a soft round-pear shape; dot tiny seeds inside.
G? ... Guava! Make an oval fruit; dot many seeds inside.
Find H, hold the beat ... Horseradish! Trace one long root below the soil line.
I ... Indian Fig! Make a cactus-fruit oval; dot many seeds inside.
Remember J ... Jackfruit! Show one huge oval; dot a bumpy rind.
K? ... Kale! Fan one broad ruffled leaf.
Find L, hold the beat ... Leek! Trace a pale layered stalk; lift long green leaves.
Letter calls, color replies!
Name the produce with your eyes!
M ... Melon! Make a round rind; cup a seeded center.
Remember N ... Nectarine! Make a smooth round fruit; tap one pit at center.
O? ... Okra! Trace a ridged pod; dot seed rows inside.
Find P, hold the beat ... Peach! Make a fuzzy round fruit; tap one pit at center.
Q ... Quince! Make an apple-pear shape; point to the seed core.
Remember R ... Raspberry! Cluster many tiny drupelet dots together.
S? ... Strawberry! Make a heart-like berry; dot seeds on the outside.
Find T, hold the beat ... Turnip! Trace a round root below soil; lift leafy greens.
U ... Ugli Fruit! Make a round citrus shape; roughen the loose rind.
Remember V ... Vanilla Bean! Trace one long narrow pod.
W? ... Watercress! Dot small round leaves along branching stems.
Find X, hold the beat ... Xoconostle! Make a cactus-fruit oval; mark thick skin and seeds.
Letter calls, color replies!
Name the produce with your eyes!
Y ... Yam! Trace an uneven tuber below the soil line.
Remember Z ... Zucchini! Trace one long green squash.
Letter calls, color replies!
Letters tucked in—our garden-market tune is ours to keep!
